name: Onakke
description: An ancient civilization of horned or tusked ogres of Shandalar, wiped out by a purplish cloud in a vision, whose spirits haunt the Chain Veil.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, and her earlier ill-fated visit to learn of the Onakke.
timeline.quote: Instead of bringing it back to him like a good little retriever, she'd used its power to kill him.

timeline.summary: Liliana's tattoos bleed as the Onakke voices fall silent, and she sees a vision of the Onakke city in which a purplish cloud obliterates the ogres.
timeline.quote: A cascade of meteors streaked across the sky as the Onakke were utterly obliterated before her eyes.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises an Onakke skeleton to take the veil, but it will not leave and she destroys it; the veil ends up hanging from her arm.
timeline.quote: She stared at the veil in horror as bones clattered to the floor all around her.

timeline.summary: An Onakke spirit calls her vessel and tells her the root planted when she killed her brother will bloom into destruction; it also says she acts to avoid following Josu into the void.
timeline.quote: Everything you've done has been to avoid following Josu into the void.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains the Chain Veil's power to extinguish the Onakke spirit at great pain but still cannot drop the veil.
timeline.quote: And like a snuffed candle flame, the spirit vanished.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
timeline.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws on the Chain Veil, killing undead across the Morass.
timeline.quote: The Onakke bound into the Chain Veil whispered in her mind as she drew on raw power.

relations.note: The Chain Veil is the Onakke's veil and haunted by their spirits.
relations.quote: We are beyond the reach of your magic,

relations.note: holds the spirits of the Onakke dead
relations.quote: the Chain Veil, and with it the spirits of the Onakke dead.
